title: 第21章 人魂合一海王日记圣女小心思第22章 师妹这个速度正常么实力暴涨
slug: 双生神级武魂震惊妖帝老婆
content_zh:
;;
“对！”
提及正事，白莹玥收起嬉戏态度，露出认真之色。
“武魂需要正确的操控技巧才能展现真正的威力。”
“想必你刚才战斗的时候应该已经有所体会了。”
洛凡尘点头。
“确实，我刚才在使用青莲武魂治疗能力的时候还好，但在战斗的同时操纵小泥鳅一同进攻就分心乏术了，感觉它帮不上忙。”
白莹玥解答道：
“师哥这青莲属于器武魂，操控时给一个念头便可以，而小泥鳅属于兽武魂，战斗时一心二用自然展现不出真正的威力。”
“青莲是器武魂？”洛凡尘诧异道：“它不应该是植物武魂么？”
白莹玥耐心道：
“草、木、藤、莲确实属于植物武魂，日、月、雷、电，属于天象武魂，天下武魂千奇百怪，细分之下，武魂的种类实在是太多了，难以辨别。”
“但是从本质上区分的话，天下武魂其实只有两种。”
“哪两种？”
洛凡尘追问。
白莹玥答道：“兽武魂和器武魂。”
“能与魂师进行人魂合一的武魂，便是兽武魂。”
“不能的，便是器武魂。”
“怎么样，这样区分简单吧。”白莹玥觉得自己说话可能太凶了，不好意思的吐了吐丁香小舌：“那个，小师哥你别害怕，我做正事的时候就下意识比较严肃，嘻嘻。”
“不碍事，你继续说。”

洛凡尘摇头，压根没在意这些。
神殿圣女所掌握的知识，一定都是无数前辈强者总结下来的宝贵经验。
站在伟人的肩膀上，总比自己瞎琢磨提升实力快多了。
提及人魂合一，他心中已然有所感悟猜测，仿佛即将打开新世界的大门。
就差临门一脚。
白莹玥恢复严肃，继续道：
“人魂合一简单来说就是引魂入体，让你的兽武魂进行附身，与你的身体合二为一。”
“大幅度增幅你的力量。”
“唰！”
白莹玥背后一轮紫月升起，娇吟一声。
“武魂，附体！”
那一轮紫月瞬间扩大一人高，与白莹玥的娇躯重叠，合二为一。
“轰！”
白莹玥体表紫光萦绕，眉心浮现一轮紫月，睫毛结起冰霜，全身白皙的肌肤都散发着冰冷刺骨的寒气。
本就娇艳欲滴的美颜，更增添了几分妖异清冷的魅力，惊人的魅力让人难以抗拒。
圣女的言传身教，让洛凡尘脑中犹如一道闪电划破迷雾，瞬间明悟。
人魂合一才是正途。
content_en:
;;
"Yes!"
When it came to business, Bai Yingyue put away her playful attitude and showed seriousness.
"Martial spirits require correct control skills to show their true power."
"You must have experienced it during the battle just now."
Luo Fanchen nodded.
"Indeed, I was fine when I used the healing ability of the Qinglian Martial Spirit just now, but when I controlled the little loach to attack at the same time as fighting, I became distracted and lost my ability. I feel like it can't help."
Bai Yingyue answered:
"Senior brother, this Qinglian belongs to the weapon martial soul. You only need to give it a thought when controlling it. However, the little loach belongs to the beast martial soul. Naturally, it cannot show its true power by focusing on two things during battle."
"Qinglian is a weapon martial spirit?" Luo Fanchen asked in surprise: "Shouldn't it be a plant martial spirit?"
Bai Yingyue said patiently:
"Grass, wood, vines, and lotus are indeed plant spirits. The sun, moon, thunder, and lightning are celestial spirits. There are all kinds of strange spirits in the world. When broken down, there are so many types of spirits that it is difficult to distinguish them."
"But in terms of their essence, there are actually only two kinds of martial spirits in the world."
"Which two?"
Luo Fanchen asked.
Bai Yingyue replied: "Beast martial soul and weapon martial soul."
"The martial soul that can merge with the soul master's human soul is the beast martial soul."
"What can't be done is the weapon soul."
"Well, let's make it easier to distinguish." Bai Yingyue felt that she might have spoken too harshly, and she spat out her tongue in embarrassment: "Well, junior brother, don't be afraid, I am subconsciously more serious when doing business, hehe."
"It's okay, keep talking."
Luo Fanchen shook his head and didn't care about this at all.
The knowledge mastered by the temple saint must be the valuable experience summed up by countless powerful seniors.
Standing on the shoulders of great men is much faster than trying to improve your strength by yourself.
When it comes to the unity of human and soul, he already has some insights and speculations in his heart, as if he is about to open the door to a new world.
Just the last step.
Bai Yingyue regained her seriousness and continued:
"To put it simply, the fusion of human souls means bringing the soul into the body, allowing your beast martial soul to possess it and become one with your body."
"Significantly increase your power."
"Uh-huh!"
A purple moon rose behind Bai Yingyue and she moaned.
"Martial spirit, possessed!"
The purple moon instantly expanded to the height of a person, overlapped with Bai Yingyue's delicate body, and merged into one.
"Boom!"
Purple light lingers on Bai Yingyue's body, a purple moon appears between her eyebrows, her eyelashes are frosted, and her fair skin is exuding a biting cold air.
The already delicate and charming beauty adds a bit of enchanting and cold charm, and the amazing charm is irresistible.
The saint's words and deeds made Luo Fanchen's mind like a bolt of lightning piercing the fog, and he suddenly understood.
The unity of man and soul is the right path.
